Free OpenWeatherMap key — about 2 minutes
  1. Create a free account ↗ — just an email & password.
  2. Open your API keys page ↗; a default key is already listed — copy it.
  3. Paste it in the box above. New keys take ~10 min to 2 h to activate — a ✓ appears here once it works.
Your key stays on this device only. Weatherglass is free; OpenWeatherMap's free tier is plenty for personal use.

Weatherglass
Where the sky takes shape.

An offline climate atlas that gains a live pulse on request. The whole world's climate normals are baked in and read with the wire pulled; current conditions, forecasts, warnings and raster layers are fetched only when you ask for them.

Data & credits

    Privacy

    Your home pins and OpenWeatherMap key live in this browser only and are never sent anywhere. The app boots with no network at all; it reaches out only for the live data you request, sending just the coordinates needed.

    Weatherglass — free and offline-first. Every reading shows its time; offline, the baked normals stand.
